summary: Master sexuality and gender education using UNESCO ITGSE and SOGIESC frameworks. Design inclusive curricula and lead gender mainstreaming. Enroll today.
lede: Comprehensive sexuality education training helps programme managers, gender advisers, health educators and safeguarding officers design and improve learning programmes. It covers curriculum mapping, gender analysis, inclusive lesson design, sensitive-question facilitation, consent education, and safeguarding and referral planning. Participants also practise stakeholder engagement and outcome monitoring to support safe, accessible delivery and track implementation.
audienceIntro: Sexuality education training is designed for professionals who develop, deliver, govern, or evaluate learning and protection activities involving sexuality, gender, relationships, health, and inclusion.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in education, health promotion, gender programming, safeguarding, youth services, or related programme coordination. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with your organization’s sexuality education materials, safeguarding procedure, or monitoring data will improve the applied exercises, but no confidential case information should be brought into the course.
